listing.title: Handwoven Banarasi Cotton Shawl with Intricate Gold Zari Work
listing.description: Woven in the historic craft cluster of Banaras, this exquisite shawl is a testament to the artisan's mastery of the traditional handloom. Each piece takes four days of meticulous labor to complete, featuring intricate gold zari patterns against a deep, dark cotton base. This craft represents a centuries-old heritage of textile excellence, where every thread is carefully interlaced to create a timeless accessory.
